chapters.label: Giants Stadium
chapters.text: World Cup 1994, Mexico against Bulgaria. Jorge Campos, in a bright kit he designed himself, was small for a keeper. Here's how he played: Bulgaria go long, Campos sprints off his line to win it first!

chapters.label: Off his line
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. He reads the long ball as it's kicked, and he's off his line in a flash.

chapters.label: Brave and quick
chapters.text: Outside his box he can't use his hands, so he slides in bravely and clears it, a split second before the striker.

chapters.label: Win it first
chapters.text: Not the tallest? Quick feet and bravery help you win the ball first.
